annotation.title_clean: Governance and enforcement of the AI Act
annotation.title_en: Governance and enforcement of the AI Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page describing the AI Act's governance and enforcement architecture: the AI Office, three advisory bodies, national market surveillance and notifying authorities, and cooperation with fundamental rights protection authorities. It also mentions a July 2026 action plan on cybersecurity and AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Office and national market surveillance authorities implement, supervise and enforce the AI Act.
Three advisory bodies: European AI Board, Scientific Panel, Advisory Forum.
Member States had to designate national competent authorities by 2 August 2025.
Notifying authorities designate and supervise notified bodies for pre-market conformity assessment.
Fundamental rights authorities have rights to be informed and to request information on serious incidents.
